department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: The catalog gives no department deadline for this PhD; the Graduate School priority date for international Fall applicants is March 1.
deadline.quote: International Student Priority: March 1 Priority: August 1 $75 Secondary: April 30 Secondary: September 30 $135

gre_subject.value: Engineering PhDs have no subject GRE test.

gre_general.value: Applicants submit an official GRE General score, or a support letter from an ECE graduate faculty member instead.
gre_general.quote: Official GRE General test score, or a support letter from an ECE graduate faculty member at Wichita State.

supervisor.value: Bachelor's-only applicants are admitted only if a faculty member agrees to be their PhD advisor from the start; master's applicants are judged individually.
supervisor.quote: applicants with a bachelor's degree will only be admitted if a faculty member judges them as exceptional, and is willing to be their PhD advisor from the beginning of the program

funding.value: The catalog gives no funding rule for this PhD; the Graduate School's assistantship range is not a per-student guarantee.
funding.quote: assistantships for 20 hours of work per week for a nine-month period range from $5,800 to $25,000

entry_route.value: Applicants may hold a bachelor's or a master's degree with at least a 3.250 GPA in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science or a related field.
entry_route.quote: A completed bachelor's or master’s degree, with a grade point average of at least 3.250 in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science or a related field.

notes: The catalog's PhD covers electrical and computer engineering and computer science in one program. Department web pages are blocked.
name: PhD in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
